---
name: grilling
description: Use when a consequential product decision is unsettled and the smallest complete plan needs clarifying.
---

# Clarify a plan

Inspect the symptom and current behaviour with [problem-finding](../problem-finding/SKILL.md). State the user need, evidence, release, requirement IDs, intended result, protected behaviour and acceptance checks.

Ask one focused question at a time, and only when the answer changes scope, money, data purpose or authority. Recommend an option with its trade-off. Investigate facts yourself and reuse decisions already accepted. Clear tasks proceed without an interview or repeated approval.

Record accepted decisions and exclusions in the tracker and linked docs; a material architecture change needs an ADR ([domain-modeling](../domain-modeling/SKILL.md)). Build the smallest complete slice once decisions are settled; do not expand into later releases.
